chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Yazid ibn Khalifa who said:
I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): 'Indeed, Umar ibn Hanzala came to us from you with a timing.' So Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: 'Then he would not have lied against us.'

I said: 'He mentioned that you said: Verily, the first salat Allah obligated upon His Prophet (may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family) is Al-Dhuhr, and it is the word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
[17:78] Establish the prayer from the declining of the sun.

So when the sun declines, nothing prevents you except your optional prayer. Then you do not cease to be within the time until the shadow becomes one upright stature, and that is the end of the time. So when the shadow becomes one upright stature, the time of Al-Asr enters. And you do not cease to be in the time of Al-Asr until the shadow becomes two upright statures, and that is the evening.
So he said: 'He spoke the truth.'

key_terms.الظل: The shadow — cast by a vertical object, used as the primary indicator of prayer times in classical Islamic jurisprudence
key_terms.دلوك الشمس: Declining/inclining of the sun — the moment the sun passes its zenith (zawal), marking the start of Dhuhr time
key_terms.سبحتك: Your optional prayer (nafilah) — the supererogatory prayers performed before the obligatory Dhuhr
key_terms.قامة: Qamah — a unit of measurement equal to the height of a standing person, used to measure shadow length for prayer times

ai.seo_question: What are the times of Dhuhr and Asr prayers according to Imam al-Sadiq in Al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Yazid ibn Khalifa reports that Umar ibn Hanzala conveyed to him a ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) on the times of the Dhuhr and Asr prayers, citing Quran 17:78. The Imam confirmed the report by saying Umar would not lie about him. The hadith specifies that Dhuhr time begins when the sun declines and ends when the shadow equals the height of an object (one qamah), after which Asr begins and lasts until the shadow reaches two qamah (the evening). This is a foundational narration establishing the shadow-based method for determining prayer times in Shia jurisprudence.
word_analysis: one upright stature (length equal to height of object)
